Determine the value of \(x_{1}\) is the solution of the following linear system with \(n\) equations and \(n\) variables, for \(n\ge 3\).
\(\left\lbrace\begin{array}{ccc} x_1 &-& x_2 &=& -1 \\x_2 &-& x_3& =& -1 \\ &\vdots&\\x_{n-1} &-& x_n& = &-1 \\&&x_n &= &-1 \end{array}\right .\)
The solution is a function of \(n\), which depends on the parity of \(n\).
